Lex AIProblem03 / 14

The problem

Legal work is scattered across phones, paper and diaries.

How most lawyers handle client files today.

  • Files on WhatsAppClient documents arrive on WhatsApp, email and pen drives.
  • Paper gets damagedOriginals are lost, burnt or eaten by termites.
  • Slow to findOne order means flipping through hundreds of pages.
  • Too much readingLong judgments are read just for the key points.
  • Missed hearingsHearing dates live in a paper diary.
  • No backupA lost phone or crashed PC loses everything.
  • No audit trailNobody knows who opened or changed a file.
  • Privacy riskConfidential files sit on personal phones.
The gap Client files have no single safe home, and nothing reminds anyone of a hearing.
Lex AI · Cloud computing projectScattered files, missed dates
Lex AISolution04 / 14

Our solution

Lex AI gives every client file one safe home.

Each point fixes one problem from the last slide.

  • One upload pageEvery client document goes to one secure place.
  • Safe in the cloudStored on AWS S3, with every version kept.
  • Find in secondsSearch by case number, party or date.
  • AI summaryAI writes a short summary of every file.
  • Hearing remindersAI finds the date; an email goes out a day before.
  • Automatic backupCopies across AWS data centres; servers heal themselves.
  • Proof and audit logSHA-256 fingerprint and a record of every action.
  • Private by defaultEncrypted, and opened only with permission.
The result Files are safe, searchable and summarized, and every hearing gets a reminder.
Lex AI · Cloud computing projectOne safe home for every file

Lex AIReliability & TTR12 / 14

Reliability, monitoring & TTR

We break it on purpose, three ways.

TTR (time to recovery) runs from the failure to a verified fix.

  1. T0FailureSomething breaks
  2. T1DetectAlarm or alert fires
  3. T2DiagnoseLogs show why
  4. T3RecoverRestart or restore
  5. T4VerifyHealth check OK
TTRT4 − T0
A

Container crash

≤ 2 min
We trigger
docker exec app1 kill 1
Detected by
nginx and Docker see app1 exit
Recovery
Docker restarts it. app2 serves users meanwhile, so nobody sees an outage.
Measured TTR
B

Server failure

≤ 15 min
We trigger
Reboot the EC2 instance
Detected by
Route 53 check fails → CloudWatch alarm → SNS email
Recovery
The server restarts and Docker brings every container back.
Measured TTR
C

Deletion attack

≤ 15 min
We trigger
A script deletes and overwrites 20 dummy files
Detected by
CloudTrail → EventBridge → SNS email
Recovery
Locked versions can’t be erased. We restore the old version; its hash matches.
Measured TTR
Lex AI · Cloud computing projectDetect, diagnose, recover, verify
Lex AISecurity & cost13 / 14

Security & cost

Locked down, and cheap to run.

  • IAM rolesThe server can only touch one bucket and one table. No keys in code.
  • Security GroupsOnly the web port is open. SSH only from our own IP.
  • EncryptionS3, disks and DynamoDB encrypted at rest. TLS in transit.
  • Object Lock + versioningLocked versions can’t be erased during the retention period.
  • Audit trailCloudTrail records who opened or changed every file.
  • Responsible AIAI output is a draft a lawyer confirms. Dummy documents only.
